bookSourceGroup: 综合小说·公开免费章节
bookSourceComment: 逐浪官网公开免费章节。目录排除标注VIP的章节，付费内容不提供；免费名单随正常目录刷新更新。已核对《武神天下》禹枫的搜索、目录与免费正文。搜索当前支持公开第一页，推荐与男频可用于发现。

ruleToc.chapterList: @js: var es=java.getElements('.catalog-cnt .chapter-list li > a'); var out=[]; var allowed={}; var b=String(baseUrl).match(new RegExp('^https://book[.]zhulang[.]com/([0-9]+)/')); for(var i=0;i<es.size();i++){var e=es.get(i); var u=String(e.attr('href')); var m=u.match(new RegExp('^https://book[.]zhulang[.]com/([0-9]+)/([0-9]+)[.]html$')); if(b && m && m[1]===b[1] && String(e.text()).toLowerCase().indexOf('[vip]')<0){out.push(e);allowed[m[2]]=true;}} book.putVariable('readerZhulangFreeChapters',JSON.stringify({bookId:b?b[1]:'',chapters:allowed})); out;

ruleContent.content: @js: var safe=false; try{var g=JSON.parse(String(book.getVariable('readerZhulangFreeChapters')||'{}')); var m=String(baseUrl).match(new RegExp('^https://book[.]zhulang[.]com/([0-9]+)/([0-9]+)[.]html$')); safe=!!(m && g.bookId===m[1] && g.chapters && g.chapters[m[2]]===true);}catch(e){} var es=java.getElements('#read-content'); if(safe && es.size()>0){var c=es.get(0).clone(); c.select('script,style,iframe').remove(); c.html();}else{'';}
